gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-puritan: Tilt Neon draws every glyph with a glowing tube of constant width, tall in the lowercase and bold in attitude. Puritan follows in rounded, generously opened forms that make a longer passage feel gentle and easy to move through.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-questrial: Tilt Neon's tube-like strokes flare out at the c, giving the heading a loud, lit-from-within presence. And Questrial does the quieter job, its single-weight, stencil-cut sans-serif letters keeping the text modern and tidy.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-radio-canada: Tilt Neon has a flared c and tube-like strokes. Radio Canada's sans-serif letters stand tall with open curve endings, so Tilt Neon earns its keep set big and brief while the text stays steady.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-radio-canada-big: Commanding from the first glyph, Tilt Neon pairs its tube-like stroke with a big lowercase and stubby ascenders. And Radio Canada Big reads smoothly over a longer passage, its monoline skeleton and clear terminals keeping the lines unfussy.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-ruda: Ruda brings a wire-like monoline skeleton and wide-mouthed rounds, with a sizable x-height that suits the screen. And Tilt Neon sits above it with a bold, tube-like stroke, so the two feel like neon over a quiet sign.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-saira: Tilt Neon lights every letter with a constant, neon-tube stroke and a bold, commanding voice. Saira takes over below with rounded letters reaching high, though shrinking the heading would drain the glow it depends on.
gen-gf-turret-road-general-sans: Turret Road makes bold, round forms that look like open parentheses, drawn with a pen-like line. General Sans sits beneath with a taller lowercase and smooth curves, so the heading's drama gives way to something easygoing.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-orbit: Commanding and rounded, Turret Road forms its letters like open parentheses in a pen-like line. But Orbit's sans-serif characters float apart with curves stopping short, so a long read feels light and spaced out.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-syncopate: Turret Road is bold and round, shaped like open parentheses. Syncopate follows in sans-serif letters with open curves and a technical-pen steadiness, its rung-like spacing giving paragraphs a measured, ladder-like march.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-fira-sans: A c opened wide like a horseshoe gives Underdog its expressive swagger, with no shift in weight along any curve. And Fira Sans answers with a larger-than-usual x-height and wide-open s curves, a steadier voice under that loud heading.
